meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

copy.tagline: 通过追问打磨方案并自动生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在讨论中完善设计并同步产出文档
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through relentless questioning while generating docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to refine designs through discussion and produce docs simultaneously

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude扮演严厉的面试官，通过连续提问帮你打磨计划或设计，过程中会生成架构决策记录(ADR)和术语表。
howto.when: 当你明确要求进行grilling会话，或要求用领域建模技能审查方案时触发。

say.text: 请对我的项目计划进行一次grilling。
say.note: Claude会开始连续质询并生成文档。

say.text: 用grill-with-docs审查这个数据库设计。
say.note: 会进行领域建模并记录决策。

say.text: 我想用这个技能打磨我的架构方案。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude act as a relentless interviewer, refining your plan or design through probing questions, while generating ADRs and a glossary on the go.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for a 'grilling' session or request a domain-modeling review of a proposal.

say_en.note: Claude starts questioning and creates docs.

say_en.text: Use grill-with-docs to review this DB design.
I want to sharpen my architecture with this skill.
